key_insight: Quant-Arena evaluates whether LLM agents can complete the full quantitative trading research cycle, rather than just write formulas, generate code, or make isolated trading decisions. It focuses on whether resulting strategies work beyond the research period.
problem_solved: Existing benchmarks test individual tasks but do not establish whether LLM agents can turn market hypotheses into executable, historically tested strategies that generalize beyond the data used for research.
method: Introduce a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research.
Evaluate the research loop: propose a market hypothesis, implement a trading signal, test it on historical data, and decide what to retain.
Assess strategy performance beyond the research period; detailed protocols and results are not available in the supplied, truncated abstract.
impact: Quant-Arena offers practitioners a framework for evaluating LLMs as autonomous research agents rather than isolated coding tools. It emphasizes strategy generalization, not just successful implementation.
visual_elements: Circular workflow: hypothesis → signal implementation → historical testing → retain or revise.
Comparison panel: isolated-task benchmarks versus end-to-end research evaluation.
Timeline separating the research period from subsequent strategy evaluation.
Leaderboard illustration comparing LLM agents, without inventing scores or rankings.
paper_title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
paper_authors: Houde Qian, Zheng Jiang, Wenyi Li, Chenxi Xu, Xinjie Lin
